texts.facts: The petitioner is a small street food vendor by profession, running a juice and snacks shop by name "First Chance Juice and Snacks Shop" for the last six years. The petitioner has obtained Udyam Registration Certificate, Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) license and other licenses. Though there was no complaint from any quarter, the 2 nd respondent has issued Ext.P6 notice directing the petitioner to vacate the premises within seven days, failing which the fine was to be recovered under the Highway Protection Act, 1999.
